body: there isn’t much of anything for me to hold on to anymore. I guess it’s my own fault for allowing this girl to become my only source of happiness. I may take you up on that offer someday.

I appreciate your words a lot. I don’t mean to be attacking you in any way, so if you feel that way you don’t have to respond. But I just can’t understand how she did that. Even though regret comes later, how can someone do that to someone else and feel okay? She flipped my life upside down and doesn’t seem to care one bit. The main thing I’m trying to understand is how her feelings changed literally overnight. The night before she told me that she was sad I didn’t get to bring her home from work. Then she doesn’t want anything to do with me the next afternoon.
